root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify (a) the frameworks rego driver pinning the Rego language version to v0 in constraint/pkg/client/drivers/rego/driver.go (the rego.New(...) call inside eval() that passes rego.SetRegoVersion(ast.RegoV0)) and (b) OPA's parser/topdown layer that honors the per-module Rego version (ast/parser.go and topdown/eval.go). The report must name driver.go::eval as the pin site and reference at least one OPA file that decides v0/v1 syntax handling.
evaluation_criteria: Names constraint/pkg/client/drivers/rego/driver.go (or equivalent path) as the pin site for the Rego language version
Identifies the call rego.SetRegoVersion(ast.RegoV0) (or equivalent expression) as the specific cause
References at least one OPA-side file that consumes the version (ast/parser.go or topdown/eval.go)

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace the failure: user template with `import rego.v1` -> Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate controller -> framework client AddTemplate -> rego driver compilers.go::addTemplate builds compiler -> driver.go::eval calls rego.New with RegoV0 -> OPA parser rejects v1 syntax -> error returned to status condition. The chain must mention at least three of these hops, including the driver-side pin and the OPA-side rejection.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions the controller submission path (AddTemplate or constrainttemplate_controller.Reconcile)
Mentions the framework rego driver as the pin site
Mentions OPA's parser or topdown evaluator as the rejection site
Notes that the symptom only manifests for templates declaring `import rego.v1`

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must identify all three layers: the frameworks rego driver, OPA's ast/topdown internals, and Gatekeeper's ConstraintTemplate controller. The report must name each by repo or package.
evaluation_criteria: Names the constraint framework rego driver (drivers/rego)
Names OPA's ast or topdown package

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose a concrete fix in the framework driver: read the module's declared Rego version (from package or `import rego.v1` directive) and pass the matching ast.RegoVersion to the compiler and to rego.SetRegoVersion; OR expose a driver option (DriverOpt) for callers to override the version; OR default the driver to ast.RegoV1 with backward-compat for v0 modules.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes either reading the module's declared version, exposing a configurable option, or defaulting to RegoV1
Indicates the fix should live in the frameworks rego driver, not OPA itself
Notes backward-compat for templates that still rely on v0 syntax
